description: Equipements - Bornes pour véhicules électriques - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Liste des bornes pour véhicules électriques de Tours Métropole Val de Loire Les horaires sont au format Opening Hours d’OpenStreetMap. Pour plus d'informations vous pouvez consulter le wiki OSM. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are bornes électrique, véhicule. The portal shows 40 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2017-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
